name: mediconsult
description: MediConsult — secure online doctor consultation platform by Fascinora

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w api && npm run db:constraints -w api
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w api && npm run db:constraints -w api && npm run db:seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run start -w web -- --open"
